title: cynorkis squamosa
intro: Cynorkis squamosa, commonly known as the Rough-flowered Cynorkis, is a species of orchid found in tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynorkis squamosa are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and promote wound healing, thanks to the presence of bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Research has identified that the bioactive constituents of Cynorkis squamosa, including quercetin and kaempferol, contribute to its medicinal properties, supporting its use in traditional medicine.
